row: PhyX Pain Solutions is an organization that is aimed at entailing the vision of our founders Mr Mukesh Kumar Arora and Dr Nitin Kumar Arora. A venture meant for providing the much needed help and support in order to increase the reach of healthcare and rehabilitation even to the far fledged towns and villages across the globe. This will increase awareness among people regarding the evolving concept of TELEMEDICINE and TELEREHABILITATION. This concept will provide the best evidence based rehabilitation along with quality care at a price that suits every pocket. We specialize in back pain, spine, sports, and Neuro rehabilitation among others.
